title: GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit: Second Strand Synthesis
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the third part of a ten part protocol for the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit](https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/instruments-and-automation/genereader-system/generead-qiaact-lung-panels-ww/?catno=181936) which constructs molecularly bar-coded DNA libraries for digital sequencing. This protocol automates the Second strand synthesis part described in the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Handbook](https://www.qiagen.com/us/resources/download.aspx?id=1a71d98a-c45c-44fa-b4af-874cd1d2b61f&lang=en). * Part 1: [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210) * Part 2: [Reverse transcription](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-2) * Part 3: [Second strand synthesis](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-3) * Part 4: [End repair / dA tailing](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-4) * Part 5: [Adaptor ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-5) * Part 6: [Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-6) * Part 7: [Target Enrichment PCR](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-7) * Part 8: [Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-8) * Part 9: [Universal PCR Amplification](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-9) * Part 10: [Cleanup of Universal PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-10) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: The total number of DNA samples. Samples must range between 1 (minimum) and 12 (maximum). * `P20 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. ---

steps.title: Preheat thermocycler lid
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler lid temperature to 103 °C and allow it to pre‑heat.

steps.title: Cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to 4 °C and let it reach the set point.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents to each RNA sample: Nuclease‑Free Water (A1), XC Buffer (B1), RH RNase (C1), dNTP (D1), and BX Enzyme (A2). Then mix the mixture 7 times using a 4 µL volume.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Nuclease‑Free Water (A1), XC Buffer (B1), RH RNase (C1), dNTP (D1), BX Enzyme (A2) into each RNA sample.
Mix 7 times with a pipette volume of 4 µL.

steps.title: Centrifuge briefly
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the reaction plate to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Run thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place the PCR plate in the thermocycler and run: 37 °C for 7 min, then 65 °C for 10 min, then 80 °C for 10 min, then hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Centrifuge and chill
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the plate again and immediately place it on ice.
